netMultiplierScope.note: Every catalogued item carries priceBasis "list", so NET = list x netMultiplier for all four sections. Freight is quoted already net by the shipping schedule and is never multiplied. Still unconfirmed by Hoelscher: if they state that components, prehang adders or hardware are already net, remove those sections from appliesTo — leaving them here would understate those costs by 52%.

freight.source: Hoelscher Weatherstrip delivery charges, San Antonio / Austin zone
freight.note: Two separate charges. $100 net per prehung OPENING (a single door with sidelites and a transom is one opening), plus a crate & shipping charge chosen by the total unit count of the whole order. Both are quoted net and are never multiplied by netMultiplier.
